text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Work on one of the largest single suburban developments in Harare has started in Borrowdale Brooke amid growing fears among city councillors that the developers are not sticking to the conditions designed to prevent a whites-only walled mini-town arising in the northern part of the city.
- A new tax to be called the Housing Development Levy has been suggested and if approved will be deducted from the salaries of all Zimbabwean workers from May.

- More than 4,300 people have been arrested for possessing mbanje (marijuana) over the past four years in Zimbabwe's capital Harare alone, amid an upsurge in drug abuse among the youth, a regional court heard on Tuesday.
